finite_certificate_detail: Per-t summaries, failures and row hashes are regenerated in threshold_summary.json; all raw bound rows are emitted by threshold_certificate.py.

fresh_replay.scope: New threshold certificate and all 134 new graph records only; no historical whole-campaign replay.

probes.scope: 128 bounded probes plus six controls. Formula, graph DP and deletion recurrence compared for every original graph; one hub split rebuilt by deletion per graph. Same-session algorithms, no Lean or third-party review; no across-round novelty claim.

public_replay: The committed source regenerates every bound row and every graph, coefficient and selected split. Full raw rows are also supplied in the conversation archive; Git stores source and compact audit summaries, not raw-log bytes.

theorem_scope.validation: Written derivation and exact rational/algebraic certificates; not Lean or external review

threshold.scope: Same 21-type palette. Both E and P are log-concave for every t>=45; the r/h corridor is certified for every t>=47. Written proof plus exact algebra, not a full Erdos 993 theorem, Lean proof, or external review.

unresolved: Root/hub corridor at t<47 except separately certified subfamilies
